title: ECS Container Exit Code Reference Guide
description: Use this guide to classify the type of ECS failure based on the container exit code

exit_codes.meaning: Success – container exited cleanly, not a failure
Application error – generic failure in app code
Docker daemon error – container runtime issue
Permission denied – IAM or file permission issue
Command not found – bad entrypoint or image
OOMKilled – container ran out of memory
Exit status out of range – kernel or host issue

if_exit_code_missing.meaning: Node is unreachable or container never started
